questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud service types
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Platform as a Service
questions.question: Which statement best describes Platform as a Service (PaaS)?

options.text: A cloud model in which the provider manages infrastructure and platform components while the customer focuses on applications and data
Installing, configuring, patching, and maintaining the guest operating system
Typically less infrastructure customization than IaaS or PaaS
A model in which customers use a complete cloud-hosted application

questions.explanation: Platform as a Service (PaaS) is a cloud model in which the provider manages infrastructure and platform components while the customer focuses on applications and data.

The cloud provider patches and maintains the underlying operating system

questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: PaaS operating-system management: the cloud provider patches and maintains the underlying operating system.
Platform as a Service (PaaS): a cloud model in which the provider manages infrastructure and platform components while the customer focuses on applications and data.
PaaS middleware management: installing, configuring, patching, and maintaining the guest operating system.
PaaS operating-system management: platform features such as scalability and high availability that reduce the amount of infrastructure code a team must manage.
Platform as a Service (PaaS): a managed environment that lets developers build applications without maintaining the full development infrastructure.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Platform as a Service (PaaS) — a cloud model in which the provider manages infrastructure and platform components while the customer focuses on applications and data; and PaaS operating-system management — the cloud provider patches and maintains the underlying operating system.
